title: Late History Addition on the Credit Builder Accounts Early-Closure Late-Fee Relief
content:
The relief share of the early-closure late-fee relief on a Credit Builder account grows when the account has few other late fees. The late fee the relief applies to is the account's most recent late fee; the other late fees are the account's remaining late-fee entries, by their dates.

## Clause

When no late fee other than this one was charged on the account in the 12 whole calendar months before today (a fee dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 12 months earlier falls outside them), the first-late addition is added; when exactly one other was, the second-late addition; when two or more were, nothing is added for late history.

| Other late fees charged in the 12 months | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|
| none | first-late addition: 0.15 (15 percentage points) |
| exactly one | second-late addition: 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| two or more | 0.0, nothing added |

## Edge of the window (hypothetical dates)

Today is 9 October; the relief applies to a late fee dated 2 October.

| Another late fee dated | Counted as an other late fee in the 12 months? |
|---|---|
| 9 October of the previous year | no, it falls outside |
| 10 October of the previous year | yes |
| none other at all | the first-late addition applies |
